dispositions.basis: Natural measurement dependencies are retained as a bounded seed alongside the current constrained dependencies; trackNatural replaces the prior seed, subscribe/version checks remain shared, dispose clears both. Original geometry case passes.

Behavioral state changes compare cached resolved layout fields through the single resolver; geometry differences invalidate measurement, pure appearance remains Style. Shared comparator is byte-equivalent to the prior theme candidate field test; no business getters are invoked. Focus and enabled constant/getter cases pass.

Pending structure/focus share a queue bound, and valid focus requests consume the existing structuralOps counter at repair. Focus/focus and both mixed order cases pass, including the inclusive positive control.

Effective enabled and visible now traverse their respective properties. Eligibility and activeTarget explicitly combine both; readonly query and resolver preserve separate behavior meanings. Ancestor and own visibility cases pass.

Initial/known-before-read clock failure uses completed-poll fallback and the original always-minus-one regression passes. Failure first observed after read still calls decoder.timeout immediately on now<0, with no elapsed100ms evidence; independent sub2ms CSI direction sequence is corrupted.
Unmount invalidates all descendants, then removes invalid pending focus refs before repair. Node and ancestor removal cases pass; direct stale-ref use remains rejected.
Both recordCommand and commitCommand reject Canvas and Text parents as leaves before mounting. Root/nested Canvas rejection and ordinary container append/insert controls pass.

open_findings.contract: Original A/I015: preserve100ms actual keyboard idle and continue ordinary input conservatively across clock failure; no full Keyboard scope extension.
open_findings.remaining_problem: now<0 is still treated as proof of elapsed idle in the post-read ESC path. The corrected pre-read and initial -1 paths do not cover this transition.
open_findings.minimal_input: Public Application.run with the existing test-only clock link seam: complete original-visible report; clock=1000; send ESC; observe both lastInput and pre-read clock samples; switch clock to -1 while poll waits; send [A within100ms; send q to finish.
open_findings.control: Same binary/sequence without clock failure yields up:|text:q|.
open_findings.required_behavior: Handle first clock failure at every ESC timing read conservatively; preserve incoming sequence bytes and do not assert elapsed100ms without a valid timestamp or a completed100ms idle interval. Keep the new EINTR/EAGAIN distinction and probe deadline separation.

release_gates: TASK101/TASK102 remain open; source review does not close final execution/physical host acceptance.
